name: writematrix
signature:
writematrix(A, filename)
writematrix(A, filename, Name, Value)
summary: Writes a numeric or logical matrix to a delimited text file, one row per line.
doc: The file is `.txt`, `.dat` or `.csv` (no extension adds `.txt`). Values are comma-separated unless `'Delimiter'` is `'space'`, `'tab'`, `'semi'` or `'bar'`. Numbers are written in long g format (15 significant digits; single, 7), with `NaN`, `Inf`, `-Inf` and `-0` as written. `'WriteMode', 'append'` adds to the end of the file. An array with more than two dimensions is written with its trailing dimensions collapsed into columns.
differs: The file name is required: writematrix(A), which names the file after the variable, is refused.
Spreadsheet files (.xls, .xlsx) are refused; write a .csv file.
Only numeric and logical arrays: char, string, cell and complex values are refused.
Of the options, only Delimiter, WriteMode and FileType ('text') are supported.
